defs.def: to separate or make sth separate into parts （使）分开，分散，分割，分成 …

ex.s: Hannah’s Place is divided into several areas, providing shelter for people when it is so cold that   50   outdoors can mean death.
ex.t: 汉娜之家分为几个区域，为人们提供庇护，因为天气太冷时，   50   在户外可能意味着死亡。

ex.s: To do so, I divided the book into two parts.
ex.t: 为此，我把这本书分成了两部分。

ex.s: The key finding of the study was that when crowds were further divided into smaller groups that were allowed to have a discussion, the averages from these groups were more accurate than those from an equal number of independent individuals.
ex.t: 这项研究的关键发现是，当人群被进一步分成可以进行讨论的小组时，这些小组的平均值比同等数量的独立个体的平均值更准确。

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分成两组。

ex.s: Household waste can be roughly divided into: food waste non-recyclable waste recyclable waste.
ex.t: 家庭垃圾可以大致分为：厨余垃圾、不可回收垃圾、可回收垃圾。

ex.s: How are campers divided into different groups?
ex.t: 营员是如何被分成不同小组的？

defs.def: to separate sth into parts and give a share to each of a number of different people, etc. 分配；分享；分担

ex.s: Established matrix gardens should not need the life support we give most gardens: fertilizer, dividing, regular watering.
ex.t: 成熟的矩阵花园不需要我们给大多数花园提供的那种生命支持：肥料、分株和定期浇水。

defs.def: to use different parts of your time, energy, etc. for different activities, etc. 把（时间、精力等）分别用于
to separate two people or things 使分离；使分开
to be the real or imaginary line or barrier that separates two people or things 是 … 的分界线；分隔；把 … 隔开

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: At that time, America was bitterly divided.
ex.t: 那时，美国处于严重的分裂之中。

ex.s: The province of Newfoundland and Labrador is divided into two unequal areas: Labrador is the much larger mainland territory to the north, while Newfoundland is the smaller island to the south.
ex.t: 纽芬兰和拉布拉多省分为两个面积不均的区域：拉布拉多是北面大得多的大陆区域，而纽芬兰是南面较小的岛屿。

defs.def: to separate into two parts that lead in different directions 道路

ex.s: The day is divided into two thematic sessions per age group.
ex.t: 每天按年龄组分两个主题时段。

defs.def: to make two or more people disagree 使产生分歧；使意见不一

ex.s: The resulting story in the local newspaper divided the people of the town: some were in favour of the new shopping mall, and some were against it.
ex.t: 当地报纸上刊登的报道使镇上的人产生了分歧：一些人支持新建购物中心，另一些人则反对。

ex.s: It has been an enormously positive force." Watched by millions, the ending to the race has divided opinions: should the brothers have been disqualified or highly praised for their actions?
ex.t: “它一直是一股极为积极的力量。”在数百万人的注视下，比赛结局引发了分歧：兄弟俩的行为应该被取消资格，还是受到高度赞扬？

defs.def: to find out how many times one number is contained in another 除以

ex.s: To calculate your speed as you do, divide 3,600(the number of seconds in an hour)by the number of seconds it takes you to travel one mile(the distance between two mileposts).
ex.t: 要计算你的速度，像你那样，用3600（一小时的秒数）除以你走一英里（两个里程标之间的距离）所花的秒数。

defs.def: to be able to be multiplied to give another number 除
a difference between two groups of people that separates them from each other 不同；差异；分歧
a line of high land that separates two systems of rivers 分水岭；分水线
